title: Fossil-free steel production ready for industrialisation
lineage: Dated project summary of pilot campaigns. The report’s prospective readiness judgment and cumulative pilot quantities measure different things.

passages.locator: From iron ore pellets to iron with hydrogen, Pilot trials for direct reduction
passages.quote: More than 5000 tonnes of fossil-free sponge iron have been produced so far.
passages.note: Cumulative pilot production reported by August 2024, not annual output or installed commercial capacity.

passages.locator: From iron to steel, Pilot trials in Swerim’s electric arc furnace
passages.quote: More than 1000 tonnes of steel have been produced
passages.note: Separate experimental melting trials, distinct in scope from the July 2021 Oxelösund rolling event.
